title: The DLX/Notch axis is necessary for spatiotemporal regulation of neural cell fate.
snippet: Neuronal-glial cell fate switch during forebrain development is highly regulated. DLX transcription factors are necessary for promoting GABAergic interneuron differentiation and migration but the mechanisms for concomitant repression of glial fate in neural progenitors remain elusive.
